hooks.name: COBOL changed: re-verify the port
hooks.description: When legacy COBOL changes, make the agent re-run the proof and bring the port back into line, treating the COBOL as the source of truth.

action.prompt: A legacy COBOL program in cobol/programs/ was just changed. The COBOL is the source of truth. Run `npm run test:equivalence` for that program. If its port now diverges, update the matching port in src/ports/ (and shared rules in src/semantics/ if the behaviour is general) until it matches the COBOL exactly, even if the COBOL behaviour looks like a bug. Keep the quoted COBOL statement comments in the port in sync. Then add a short entry to docs/kiro-journal.md saying what changed, what the shrunk counterexample was, and how the port was fixed.
